scripts.dev: python3 -c "import http.server, socketserver; h=http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler; h.extensions_map.update({'.js':'application/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.xlsx':'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'}); socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address=True; socketserver.TCPServer(('0.0.0.0',3000),h).serve_forever()"
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html style.css app.js xlsx-engine.js dist/ && ([ -d data ] && cp -r data dist/ || true)
